intro: We currently ship within Pakistan and to the following international destinations. Don't see your country listed? Message us on WhatsApp — we can often still arrange delivery.

timelines.time: +5 – 10 working days production time before dispatch

charges.title: Pakistan Orders
charges.text: Flat-rate courier delivery nationwide. Cash on Delivery (COD) available in most cities, or prepay via bank transfer / JazzCash / Easypaisa.

charges.title: International Orders
charges.text: Shipping cost depends on destination and order weight — we calculate and confirm this with you on WhatsApp before you pay.

charges.title: How You Pay
charges.text: International customers can pay via bank transfer, Western Union, or another method we agree on together — confirmed securely over WhatsApp.

customsNote: Depending on your country, local customs authorities may apply import duties or taxes on your order. These charges are set by your government and are the responsibility of the customer — they are not included in our product or shipping prices.
